title: Five Discourses on Not Distinguishing Form, Etc.
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 33.26–30 Linked Discourses 33.26–30
  • 1. Vacchagottavagga 1. With Vacchagotta

Rūpaasallakkhaṇādisuttapañcaka Five Discourses on Not Distinguishing Form, Etc.

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Rūpe kho, vaccha, asallakkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, asallakkhaṇā …pe…. “Vaccha, it is because of not distinguishing form …”

Tiṁsatimaṁ.
